name: Tractor
summary: Farm tractor with big rear wheels and a cab, in side view; room-scale vehicle for farm, field and countryside scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheels stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 830 px wide and 690 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.5 for a smaller scene

params.name: anim
params.note: roll = the wheels turn and the tractor rocks as it moves

author: krakujs
